receiver_side.broadcast_accounting_note: Sender emissions and charged bytes are counted once per broadcast at the sender; recipient attempts/deliveries/losses are separate receiver-side counts.
receiver_side.loss_identity_limit: Losses are recorded per emission as aggregate recipient counts. The logs do not identify which receiver lost each packet.

sender_side.automatic_packet_retries: not recorded as a separate event type; each send is a broadcast emission with recipient attempts, and later non-first sends are classified as refreshes
sender_side.budget_exhaustion_treatment: The collector masks non-affordable candidates to HOLD before execution; this differs from an executor refusal.

cross_seed_notes: Per-receiver delivery outcomes are counted separately from sender emissions; a broadcast can create multiple recipient outcomes.
A superseded result shows that the receiver rejected that arriving revision as older than its known view; the source and time of that other view are not logged.
An accepted/applied message does not by itself establish assignment or task benefit.

metric_semantics.attempt: one recipient attempt within a broadcast
metric_semantics.charged_bytes: sender-side payload-attempt bytes charged by the relay, independent of whether an individual recipient receives the packet
metric_semantics.first_report: an emission whose recorded first flag is true for that target; it does not guarantee a successful or accepted receiver delivery
metric_semantics.refresh: a later non-first emission for the target; the transcript has no separate automatic retry event class
